title: Tracking Inequality: Teachers and the Allocation of Educational Opportunities
title_zh: 追踪不平等：教师与教育机会的分配
title_primary: 追踪不平等：教师与教育机会的分配
title_secondary: Tracking Inequality: Teachers and the Allocation of Educational Opportunities
authors: Michela Carlana, Eleonora Patacchini, Francesca Miserocchi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Professionals routinely make consequential decisions for others without systematically observing how those decisions turn out. Whether such decisions reflect accurate forecasting or systematically distorted beliefs has important implications for equality of opportunity. We study this question in the context of teachers’ recommendations for high school tracks by combining nationwide administrative data, randomized vignette experiments, belief elicitation, and a field experiment. Holding students’ academic performance and interests constant, teachers are significantly less likely to recommend demanding academic tracks when students come from disadvantaged socioeconomic backgrounds. This differential treatment is accompanied by systematically inaccurate beliefs: teachers substantially overestimate the probability that high-achieving disadvantaged students will fail in academically demanding schools. We then provide teachers with personalized feedback on their previous recommendations and objective information on the realized success of disadvantaged students. The intervention substantially reduces socioeconomic gaps in recommendations for high-achieving students. Effects are concentrated among boys assigned to teachers with the largest prior recommendation gaps and the most inaccurate beliefs. Among the high-achieving disadvantaged boys most affected by the intervention, these changes translate into higher enrollment in demanding academic tracks, without detectable adverse effects on short-run academic performance.
abstract_zh: 专业人士经常为他人做出具有重大影响的决策，却未能系统性地观察这些决策的实际结果。此类决策究竟是准确预测还是系统性扭曲的信念，对于机会平等具有深远意义。我们结合全国性行政数据、随机化情境实验、信念诱导及实地实验，在教师对高中分轨建议的背景下研究这一问题。在控制学生学业表现和兴趣不变的情况下，当学生来自社会经济背景不利的家庭时，教师显著降低推荐其进入要求严格的学术轨道的可能性。这种差异对待伴随着系统性不准确的信念：教师大幅高估了高成就但处于不利地位的学生在学术要求严格的学校中失败的概率。随后，我们向教师提供关于其先前建议的个性化反馈，以及关于不利地位学生实际成功情况的客观信息。这一干预显著缩小了高成就学生在建议中的社会经济差距。其效果集中于那些先前建议差距最大且信念最不准确的教师所指导的男生。在受干预影响最大的高成就不利地位男生中，这些变化转化为进入要求严格的学术轨道的更高入学率，且未对短期学业表现产生可检测的不利影响。

title: Big Push in Distorted Economies
title_zh: 扭曲经济中的大推动
title_primary: 扭曲经济中的大推动
title_secondary: Big Push in Distorted Economies
authors: Francisco Buera, Hugo Hopenhayn, Yongseok Shin, Nicholas Trachter, Chirantan Chatterjee 等
official: 官方在线 2021-03-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we develop a quantitative model that features complementarity in firms' technology adoption decisions: The gains from adoption are larger when more firms adopt. When this complementarity is strong, multiple equilibria and hence coordination failures are possible. More important, even without equilibrium multiplicity, the model elements responsible for the complementarity can substantially amplify the effect of distortions and policies. In what we call the Big Push region, the impact of idiosyncratic distortions is over three times larger than in models without such complementarity. This amplification enables our model to nearly fully account for the income gap between India and the US without coordination failures playing a role.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个定量模型，该模型体现了企业技术采纳决策中的互补性：当更多企业采纳时，采纳的收益更大。当这种互补性较强时，可能出现多重均衡，从而引发协调失灵。更为重要的是，即使不存在均衡多重性，导致互补性的模型要素也能显著放大扭曲和政策的影响。在我们所称的“大推动”区域，特质性扭曲的影响比无此类互补性的模型高出三倍以上。这种放大效应使我们的模型能够在无需协调失灵的情况下，几乎完全解释印度与美国之间的收入差距。

title: Measuring the Stringency of Building Height Regulations
title_zh: 衡量建筑高度法规严格程度
title_primary: 衡量建筑高度法规严格程度
title_secondary: Measuring the Stringency of Building Height Regulations
authors: Yusuke Adachi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study proposes a novel methodology to measure the stringency of building height regulations. This measure gauges the difference in building heights with and without regulations. The primary challenge is to recover unobserved building heights in the absence of regulations. I develop a dynamic discrete choice model of building height decision‐making by parcel owners and conduct a counterfactual experiment that removes height regulations. An application to residential buildings in central Tokyo presents three findings. Without height restrictions, the number of stories would increase by 2.7%, and housing prices would change by 3.7%. Regulatory stringency is stronger near the central area, while the static model tends to overestimate it.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种新颖的方法来衡量建筑高度管制的严格程度。该度量方法评估了有无管制情况下建筑高度的差异。主要挑战在于恢复无管制条件下未被观测到的建筑高度。我构建了一个地块所有者关于建筑高度决策的动态离散选择模型，并进行了一项反事实实验，即移除高度管制。以东京中心城区的住宅建筑为应用对象，研究得出三项发现：若无高度限制，楼层数将增加2.7%，房价将变动3.7%；管制严格程度在中心区域附近更为显著，而静态模型往往高估了这一严格程度。

title: Nominal GDP targeting and the tax burden
title_zh: 名义GDP目标与税收负担
title_primary: 名义GDP目标与税收负担
title_secondary: Nominal GDP targeting and the tax burden
authors: Michael Hatcher, Juyi Lyu
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent work suggests that nominal GDP targeting may raise social welfare, but fiscal considerations have largely been ignored. We study an overlapping generations model with government debt and distortionary taxes. Nominal GDP targeting has two opposing effects on the tax burden: mean taxes increase, but tax volatility is reduced. Differently to previous works, we find that nominal GDP targeting lowers social welfare relative to inflation targeting. A key mechanism is that nominal GDP targeting makes inflation countercyclical, thereby raising long run inflation risk and consumption risk of retirees while increasing the inflation risk premium paid on government debt.
abstract_zh: 近期研究指出，名义GDP目标化可能提升社会福利，但财政方面的考量在很大程度上被忽视了。我们研究了一个包含政府债务和扭曲性税收的代际重叠模型。名义GDP目标化对税收负担产生两种相反的影响：平均税收增加，但税收波动性降低。与以往研究不同，我们发现名义GDP目标化相对于通胀目标化降低了社会福利。一个关键机制在于，名义GDP目标化使通胀呈现逆周期特性，从而增加了长期通胀风险及退休人员的消费风险，同时提高了政府债务所支付的通胀风险溢价。

title: The politics of climate adaptation in Nepal: authority, knowledge, and resource inequality in multi-level governance
title_zh: 尼泊尔气候适应的政治：多层治理中的权威、知识与资源不平等
title_primary: 尼泊尔气候适应的政治：多层治理中的权威、知识与资源不平等
title_secondary: The politics of climate adaptation in Nepal: authority, knowledge, and resource inequality in multi-level governance
authors: Suman Acharya
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Contemporary approaches to climate change adaptation increasingly emphasize multi-level stakeholder engagement. These approaches seek to advance sustainability, equity, and inclusion while addressing the social, environmental, economic, and political needs of present and future generations. Although technocratic adaptation addresses biophysical climate risks, it often neglects socio-political forces that shape vulnerability and can intensify long-term climate risks and inequalities. This paper utilizes a multi-level governance framework to examine the political dimensions of climate adaptation, focusing on the dynamics of authority, knowledge, and resource access. Building on literature on the political dimensions of climate change adaptation, this study draws on ethnographic data to examine how power is exercised, negotiated, and resisted across multiple governance scales in Nepal. Focusing on the Karnali region, it shows that despite formally democratic multi-level institutions, adaptation authority remains centralized at the federal level and shaped by corruption, reinforcing exclusion and elite capture. As federal, provincial, and local governments compete over authority, knowledge production, and resource control, Nepal’s multi-level adaptation governance reinforces power differentials and elite influence while marginalizing vulnerable communities, thereby limiting transformative and just climate adaptation. This paper argues that effective adaptation requires accountable multi-level governance rather than decentralization alone. Meaningful subnational authority must be matched by cross-scale coordination, transparency, and oversight so that decision-making, resources, and knowledge are not captured by elites at any level.
abstract_zh: 当代气候变化适应方法日益强调多层级利益相关者的参与。这些方法旨在推进可持续性、公平与包容，同时满足当代及未来世代在社会、环境、经济和政治方面的需求。尽管技术官僚式的适应措施应对了生物物理气候风险，却往往忽视了塑造脆弱性的社会政治力量，并可能加剧长期气候风险与不平等。本文运用多层级治理框架，审视气候适应的政治维度，重点关注权力、知识与资源获取的动态关系。基于气候变化适应政治维度的相关文献，本研究利用民族志数据，考察权力如何在尼泊尔多个治理层级中被行使、协商与抵制。聚焦卡尔纳利地区的研究表明，尽管存在形式上民主的多层级机构，适应权力仍集中于联邦层面，并受腐败影响，从而强化了排斥与精英俘获现象。随着联邦、省和地方政府在权力、知识生产及资源控制上相互竞争，尼泊尔的多层级适应治理强化了权力差异与精英影响力，同时边缘化了脆弱社区，从而限制了变革性和公正的气候适应。本文认为，有效的适应需要问责制的多层级治理，而非仅靠权力下放。有意义的地方层级权力必须与跨层级协调、透明度和监督相匹配，以确保决策、资源和知识不被任何层级的精英所垄断。

title: ‘Rentierism’ at the peri-urban edge: Studentification, speculative land markets, and the uneven geographies of gentrification in Ghana
title_zh: 城乡边缘的“食利主义”：学生化、投机性土地市场与加纳绅士化进程的不均衡地理
title_primary: 城乡边缘的“食利主义”：学生化、投机性土地市场与加纳绅士化进程的不均衡地理
title_secondary: ‘Rentierism’ at the peri-urban edge: Studentification, speculative land markets, and the uneven geographies of gentrification in Ghana
authors: Frederick Mensah, S. Liwur, Francisca Agyei, M. Asibey
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Rapid urbanisation around major educational institutions are increasingly transforming peri-urban settlements in African cities, yet the mechanisms and consequences of these changes remain underexplored. This study examines the processes, drivers, and impacts of gentrification in Ayeduase, a peri-urban community adjacent to the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) in Kumasi, Ghana. Drawing on a mixed-methods case study approach, the study combines household surveys, key informant interviews, field observations, and GIS-based land-use analysis to investigate how university expansion influences land-use change, housing development, and socio-economic transformation. The findings reveal that growing demand for student accommodation has stimulated the conversion of traditional residential properties into hostels, apartments, commercial facilities, and mixed-use developments. Between 2005 and 2025, residential land declined substantially while commercial and mixed-use land uses expanded, accompanied by sharp increases in land values and intensified redevelopment activity. Although these changes have generated employment opportunities, business growth, and higher household incomes for some residents, they have also contributed to rental pressures, exclusionary displacement, socio-cultural change, and the weakening of long-standing community networks. The study argues that the transformation of Ayeduase is best understood as a form of institution-driven gentrification, in which university expansion creates the conditions for market-led redevelopment within a fragmented governance environment characterised by the interaction of customary and statutory land administration systems. The study advances understanding of how gentrification unfolds in rapidly urbanising African contexts, and highlight the need for integrated planning approaches that balance economic development, housing accessibility, and social inclusion in university-adjacent settlements.
abstract_zh: 非洲城市主要教育机构周边的快速城市化正日益改变城郊聚落，然而这些变化的机制与后果仍未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了加纳库马西市夸梅·恩克鲁玛科技大学（KNUST）邻近城郊社区阿耶杜阿塞的绅士化过程、驱动因素及影响。采用混合方法案例研究路径，结合住户调查、关键知情人访谈、实地观察和基于GIS的土地利用分析，探讨大学扩张如何影响土地利用变化、住房开发和社会经济转型。研究发现，学生住宿需求的增长推动了传统住宅物业向宿舍、公寓、商业设施及混合用途开发的转变。2005年至2025年间，住宅用地大幅减少，而商业和混合用途用地扩张，同时伴随土地价值急剧上升和再开发活动加剧。尽管这些变化为部分居民创造了就业机会、商业增长和更高的家庭收入，但也导致了租金压力、排斥性迁移、社会文化变迁以及长期社区网络的弱化。研究认为，阿耶杜阿塞的转型最好被理解为一种机构驱动的绅士化形式，其中大学扩张在习惯法与法定土地管理制度相互作用所形成的碎片化治理环境中，为市场主导的再开发创造了条件。本研究增进了对绅士化如何在快速城市化的非洲背景下展开的理解，并强调了在高校邻近聚落中需要采取兼顾经济发展、住房可及性和社会包容性的综合规划方法。

title: Interest rates and bank runs
title_zh: 利率与银行挤兑
title_primary: 利率与银行挤兑
title_secondary: Interest rates and bank runs
authors: Timur Magzhanov, Anton Polous
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how high short-term interest rates affect depositor withdrawals and bank fragility. In a global games model, depositors choose between bank deposits and money market funds, while bank holds short-term and long-term assets. Higher rates raise the payoff from withdrawing and reduce long-term asset recovery values. The model delivers a critical interest rate threshold above which runs occur, conditional on bank balance-sheet fundamentals. Lower switching cost, weaker long-term asset returns, larger fire-sale loss, and larger long-term asset share lower the threshold and expand the run region.
abstract_zh: 本文研究短期高利率如何影响储户提款行为及银行脆弱性。在一个全局博弈模型中，储户在银行存款与货币市场基金之间进行选择，而银行持有短期与长期资产。利率上升既提高了提款的收益，又降低了长期资产回收价值。该模型推导出一个关键利率阈值：当利率超过该阈值时，基于银行资产负债表基本面状况，挤兑现象将发生。较低的转换成本、较弱的长期资产回报、较大的折价抛售损失以及较高的长期资产占比，均会降低该阈值并扩大挤兑区域。

official: 聚合元数据日期 2010-11-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We present a novel and comprehensive dataset of bilateral gross and net external positions in various financial instruments for the main advanced and emerging economies and regions, designed to improve our understanding of cross-border financial linkages. The data show no strong correspondence between country or region pairs with the largest gross versus net external positions, and the importance of international financial centers, including offshore centers, in intermediating financial flows. We also highlight some important data gaps in completing a network of cross-border holdings, related to the limited available information on the size and geographical pattern of external claims and liabilities of offshore centers, oil exporters, and other mostly emerging markets.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个新颖且全面的双边总外部头寸与净外部头寸数据集，涵盖主要发达经济体与新兴经济体及地区在各类金融工具中的头寸情况，旨在深化对跨境金融关联的理解。数据显示，国家或地区对之间最大的总外部头寸与净外部头寸之间并无显著对应关系，同时凸显了国际金融中心（包括离岸中心）在金融流动中介中的关键作用。此外，我们还指出了构建跨境持有网络时存在的一些重要数据缺口，这些缺口与离岸中心、石油出口国及其他主要新兴市场在外部债权与负债规模及地理分布模式方面可获取信息的局限性相关。

title: PTSD Symptom Trajectories in the Wake of Potentially Traumatic Events: a Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 20 Years of Research

abstract: This systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression evaluates twenty years of literature on data-driven identification of common PTSD symptom trajectories following potentially traumatic events. Traditional, machine learning- and large language model–assisted systematic search approaches were combined to identify eligible articles applying statistical Growth Mixture Modeling to longitudinally assessed PTSD symptom severity. Ninety-nine studies representing 113 independent samples and 215, 136 participants from 21 countries were included. We identified five prototypical PTSD symptom trajectories that commonly occurred across samples. We determined pooled relative trajectory prevalence estimates across samples observing these specific trajectories with the low symptoms trajectory being the most and the increasing symptoms trajectory the least prevalent. Using meta-regression, various socio-demographic, exposure-related and methodological moderators of sample-level relative trajectory prevalences were identified. Our findings provide empirical support and further refinements of leading theoretical PTSD conceptualizations. Furthermore, the obtained relative prevalence estimates and sample-level moderators may inform population-tailored trauma-related mental health care.
abstract_zh: 本系统综述、荟萃分析及荟萃回归评估了二十年来关于创伤后应激障碍症状轨迹数据驱动识别的研究文献。结合传统、机器学习及大型语言模型辅助的系统检索方法，识别出符合条件的研究，这些研究应用统计增长混合模型对纵向评估的PTSD症状严重程度进行分析。共纳入来自21个国家的99项研究，涵盖113个独立样本及215,136名参与者。我们识别出五种典型的PTSD症状轨迹，这些轨迹在样本中普遍出现。我们确定了观察这些特定轨迹的样本中，轨迹相对患病率的汇总估计，其中低症状轨迹最为普遍，而症状递增轨迹最为罕见。通过荟萃回归分析，我们识别出多种社会人口学、暴露相关及方法论层面的调节变量，这些变量影响样本层面的相对轨迹患病率。我们的研究结果为领先的PTSD理论概念化提供了实证支持，并进一步加以完善。此外，所获得的相对患病率估计及样本层面调节变量可为针对人群定制的创伤相关心理健康护理提供参考。

abstract: We introduce a new family of power indices for nodes in graphs with classes. We provide an axiomatic characterization of this family and prove the independence of the axioms. Furthermore, we show that these indices coincide with the Shapley values of a family of subadditive transferable-utility games defined on such graphs. These normative results yield a general framework for quantifying structural influence in complex networks. In particular, we identify the normative conditions under which power in technological sharing networks can be represented by our family of indices. Importantly, the proposed axiomatic framework also applies to influence flows that generate negative effects.
abstract_zh: 我们针对带有类别属性的图节点引入了一类新的权力指数族，给出了该指数族的公理化刻画，并证明了各公理之间的独立性。进一步地，我们证明这些指数与定义在此类图上的次可加可转移效用博弈族中的沙普利值一致。这些规范性结论为量化复杂网络中的结构性影响提供了通用框架。特别地，我们识别出技术共享网络中权力可由本指数族表征的规范性条件。重要的是，所提出的公理化框架同样适用于产生负效应的影响力流动。

title_zh: 技术、执法资源配置与环境绩效

source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The increasing use of monitoring technologies raises important questions about their impact on regulatory strategies and enforcement outcomes. This paper studies the adoption of the Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS), a real-time pollution tracking technology in China. Using firm-level data, we find that CEMS adoption reduces corporate sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions by 16.8% and 15.8%, respectively. Mechanism analyses indicate that CEMS-generated exceedance signals increase the observability of violations and success rate of inspections. We find no evidence that CEMS adoption crowds out enforcement or increases emissions among nearby non-CEMS firms. These findings suggest that monitoring technologies can enhance regulatory precision, which is important for the extension of new monitoring technologies.
abstract_zh: 监测技术的日益普及引发了关于其对监管策略和执法效果影响的重要问题。本文研究了中国实时污染追踪技术——连续排放监测系统（CEMS）的采用情况。利用企业层面数据，我们发现CEMS的采用使企业二氧化硫（SO2）和氮氧化物（NOx）排放分别减少了16.8%和15.8%。机制分析表明，CEMS生成的超标信号提高了违规行为的可观测性和检查成功率。我们未发现CEMS采用会挤出执法或增加邻近非CEMS企业排放的证据。这些发现表明，监测技术能够增强监管精准性，这对于新监测技术的推广具有重要意义。

title: Dynamic Risk Adjustment in Markets with Persistent Risk and Manipulable Signals: Market Design for Health Insurance

official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Risk adjustment is a payment mechanism, not only a prediction problem. I extend optimal risk adjustment to dynamic insurance markets in which plans capture future residuals from persistent risk. Under an efficiency criterion, payments should reflect expected profits and losses over the enrollee relationship on margins plans control, not only one-year spending predictions. A finite-cell model separates selection, health production, and manipulable measurement. The framework implies that annual recalculation can tax prevention, high-R² prediction can reduce welfare, and lagged claims anchors are useful only with gaming safeguards.
abstract_zh: 风险调整是一种支付机制，而不仅仅是预测问题。本文将最优风险调整扩展至动态保险市场，在该市场中，保险计划可从持续性风险中获取未来残差收益。基于效率准则，支付应反映保险计划可控边际上参保人关系存续期内预期的利润与损失，而非仅基于单年支出预测。通过有限单元模型，本文分离了选择效应、健康生产效应与可操纵的测量效应。该框架表明：年度重新计算可能对预防行为产生税收效应，高R²预测可能降低社会福利，而滞后理赔锚定仅在存在博弈防范机制时才有用。

title: Quantifying Supply-Side Climate Policies
title_zh: 量化供给侧气候政策
title_primary: 量化供给侧气候政策
title_secondary: Quantifying Supply-Side Climate Policies
authors: Lassi Ahlvik, Jørgen Juel Andersen, Jonas Hveding Hamang, Torfinn Harding
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.
abstract_zh: 供给侧气候政策对石油市场有何影响？我们利用全球企业层面数据，估算了2000年至2019年间84项生产税改革对石油产量、勘探及发现量的影响。研究发现，提高税率主要降低了企业的勘探支出和石油发现量，同时减少了非常规石油的短期产量。随后，我们通过一个延伸至本世纪末的短期与中期动态模型，量化了这些影响对石油市场的含义。若对石油生产商征收20个百分点的全球气候特许权附加费，前五年内石油年均排放量将减少5%至7%，中期内减少9%至20%。若仅由经合组织国家实施该政策，中期内47%至73%的减排总量将被非经合组织国家的产量增长所抵消。

title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators
title_zh: 三重稳健面板估计量
title_primary: 三重稳健面板估计量
title_secondary: Triply Robust Panel Estimators
authors: Susan Athey, Guido Imbens, Zhaonan Qu, Davide Viviano
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，该估计量结合了基于低秩因子结构的灵活潜在结果模型（该模型建立在双向固定效应规范之上），并引入旨在提升与处理单元相似性的单元权重，以及旨在强化接近处理时间段的时期权重。我们通过一系列与多个常用真实数据集高度匹配的模拟实验，评估该估计量的表现。研究发现，不同设定下各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们进一步探究数据生成过程中哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估该估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两项建议：首选策略是研究者应按照本文讨论的思路，针对其关注的数据进行高度匹配的模拟实验，以确定在特定设定下表现良好的估计量；更简便的方法是采用SDID或新型TROP估计量等更具稳健性的估计量，我们发现这些估计量在许多实证相关设定中显著优于TWFE/DID估计量。

title: Place‐Based Land Policy and Spatial Misallocation: Theory and Evidence From China

authors: Min Fang, Libin Han, Zibin Huang, Ming Lu, Li Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate a land policy in China that allocated more urban land quotas to underdeveloped regions to reduce regional gaps. Empirically, the policy decreased productivity in eastern areas relative to the inland. A spatial equilibrium model with migration, land quota constraints, and agglomeration shows the policy distorts labor and production across regions, causing substantial output losses. Though regional gaps narrowed, workers from underdeveloped areas migrated less and earned less. Without the policy, national output would have been 1.8% higher, and workers in underdeveloped areas would have earned 1.6% more in 2010. Regional transfers offer a less distortionary alternative for reducing inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中国一项旨在通过向欠发达地区分配更多城市土地配额以缩小区域差距的土地政策。实证结果显示，该政策降低了东部地区相对于内陆地区的生产率。一个包含迁移、土地配额约束及集聚效应的空间均衡模型表明，该政策扭曲了区域间的劳动力与生产配置，导致了显著的产出损失。尽管区域差距有所缩小，但欠发达地区的工人迁移减少且收入降低。若无此政策，2010年全国产出将高出1.8%，欠发达地区工人的收入将增加1.6%。区域转移支付为缩小不平等提供了一种扭曲程度较低的替代方案。

title: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
title_zh: 比例代表制下投票率与投票行为的联合分析：理论与实验
title_primary: 比例代表制下投票率与投票行为的联合分析：理论与实验
title_secondary: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
authors: Aaron Kamm, Arthur Schram
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a system of proportional representation, we study the interaction between a voters turnout decision and her party choice, and how these relate to party polarization. Quantal response equilibria predict such interaction effects. In particular they predict (i) a Polarization Effect: reduced strategic party choice when voting is voluntary makes voters more likely to vote for extreme parties (conditional on voting at all); (ii) an Extremist Effect: voters supporting extreme parties are most likely to vote; (iii) a Turnout Effect: party polarization increases voter turnout. We provide data from a laboratory experiment that support these theoretical predictions. In addition, we provide supporting empirical evidence from real world elections. Hence, the interaction between turnout and strategic voting that has been neglected in most of the previous literature is shown to be important.
abstract_zh: 在比例代表制体系中，我们研究了选民的投票参与决策与其政党选择之间的相互作用，以及这些因素如何与政党极化相关联。量子响应均衡预测了此类交互效应。具体而言，它们预测了（i）极化效应：当投票为自愿时，策略性政党选择减少，使得选民（在决定投票的前提下）更倾向于支持极端政党；（ii）极端主义效应：支持极端政党的选民最有可能参与投票；（iii）投票率效应：政党极化提高了选民投票率。我们提供了来自实验室实验的数据，这些数据支持上述理论预测。此外，我们还提供了来自现实世界选举的实证证据作为佐证。因此，先前多数文献中忽视的投票参与与策略性投票之间的相互作用被证明是重要的。

title: Bidding for public goods
title_zh: 公共物品的竞标
title_primary: 公共物品的竞标
title_secondary: Bidding for public goods
authors: Hanjoon Michael Jung
official: 官方在线 2026-03-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce public-good auctions, a versatile framework addressing auction scenarios where players benefit not only from winning themselves but also when their competitors win. Distinct from private-good auctions, public-good auctions feature prizes as public goods enjoyed by all players and allow them to choose from multiple prizes. Demonstrating broad applicability, public-good auctions can be applied to various economic models, including auctions with externalities, and combinatorial auctions. The framework effectively explains unconventional situations marked by conflicting incentives between cooperation and competition and diverse behaviors, such as free-riding, cooperation, strategic voting, and multiple targeting, which are unobserved in traditional auction settings. Using a two-player model, we present four main results regarding the existence, characterization, and uniqueness of equilibrium payoffs.
abstract_zh: 我们引入公共品拍卖这一通用框架，用以处理拍卖场景中玩家不仅从自身获胜中获益，还从竞争对手获胜中获益的情形。与私人物品拍卖不同，公共品拍卖的特点在于奖品作为公共品为所有玩家所共享，且玩家可选择多个奖品。该框架展现出广泛的适用性，可应用于多种经济模型，包括具有外部性的拍卖和组合拍卖。此框架有效解释了传统拍卖环境中未观察到的、以合作与竞争之间激励冲突为标志的非常规情境及多样化行为，如搭便车、合作、策略性投票和多重目标设定。通过一个双玩家模型，我们提出了关于均衡收益的存在性、特征化及唯一性的四项主要结果。

title: Downstream effects of post‐Dobbs abortion bans: Birth rates and WIC
title_zh: 多布斯案后堕胎禁令的下游效应：出生率与WIC

authors: Lilly Springer
official: 官方在线 2026-03-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abortion bans tend to impact the cohorts of women that are eligible for the supplemental nutrition program special supplemental nutrition program for women, infants, and children the most. I use synthetic difference-in-differences models and 2017–2023 monthly state-level data to estimate the change in birth rates and WIC participation that states with total abortion bans experience. States that implemented total abortion bans by the start of 2023 experience a 1.6% increase in the overall birth rate in 2023 and a 4.3% and 2.1% increase in monthly postpartum women and formula-fed infant WIC participation respectively, leading to a total additional $6.9 million in food costs.
abstract_zh: 堕胎禁令往往对符合补充营养计划（即妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划，WIC）资格的妇女群体影响最大。我采用合成双重差分模型，并利用2017至2023年的月度州级数据，估算了实施全面堕胎禁令的州在出生率和WIC参与率方面的变化。截至2023年初实施全面堕胎禁令的州，其2023年总体出生率上升了1.6%，月度产后妇女和配方奶喂养婴儿的WIC参与率分别增加了4.3%和2.1%，由此导致食品成本总额额外增加了690万美元。

title: Time-Varying High Quantile Estimation for Nonstationary Tail Dependent Time Series
title_zh: 非平稳尾部相依时间序列的时变高分位数估计
title_primary: 非平稳尾部相依时间序列的时变高分位数估计
title_secondary: Time-Varying High Quantile Estimation for Nonstationary Tail Dependent Time Series
authors: Ting Zhang, Yu Shao
official: 官方在线 2025-12-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider the problem of time-varying high quantile estimation for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. Unlike the conventional quantile analysis in which the quantile level is typically assumed to be fixed, the current high quantile setting requires the quantile level to grow with the sample size to capture the tail phenomenon. In addition, for nonstationary time series data, the underlying data generating mechanism is expected to change over time, and as a result the associated time-varying high quantile can no longer be treated as a constant parameter making existing results not directly applicable. In this article, we model the underlying time-varying high quantile as a nonparametric function of time to avoid any parametric misspecification, and we establish the consistency and central limit theorem of nonparametric high quantile estimators for a general class of nonstationary tail dependent time series. It can be seen from our limit theorems that the asymptotic behavior of nonparametric high quantile estimators can be affected by both the double asymptotic scheme caused by the growing quantile level and the serial tail dependence in time series data. Numerical results are provided to illustrate the developed results, and an extension to time-varying high quantile regression models is also discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一类广泛非平稳尾部相依时间序列中时变高分为点估计的问题。与通常假设分位水平固定的传统分位分析不同，当前高分为设定要求分位水平随样本量增长以捕捉尾部现象。此外，对于非平稳时间序列数据，其背后的数据生成机制预期随时间变化，因此相关的时变高分为点不能再被视为常数参数，这使得现有结果无法直接适用。在本文中，我们将潜在的时变高分为点建模为时间的非参数函数，以避免任何参数误设，并针对一类广泛的非平稳尾部相依时间序列，建立了非参数高分为点估计量的一致性及中心极限定理。从我们的极限定理可以看出，非参数高分为点估计量的渐近行为可能同时受到由增长的分位水平引起的双重渐近方案以及时间序列数据中序列尾部相依性的影响。文中提供了数值结果以说明所发展的理论，并进一步讨论了向时变高分为回归模型的扩展。

title: Intergenerational Mobility Trends and the Changing Role of Female Labor
title_zh: 代际流动趋势与女性劳动角色的变迁
title_primary: 代际流动趋势与女性劳动角色的变迁
title_secondary: Intergenerational Mobility Trends and the Changing Role of Female Labor
authors: Ulrika Ahrsjö, René Karadakic, Joachim Kahr Rasmussen, Jon Valant, Brigham Walker 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-11-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using harmonized administrative data from Scandinavia, we find that intergenerational rank associations in income have increased uniformly across Sweden, Denmark, and Norway for cohorts born between 1951 and 1979. By gender, father-son mobility remains stable, while correlations for mothers and daughters rise. Similar patterns appear in US survey data, albeit with different timing. We show that the decline in income mobility reflects a stronger link between female income and underlying productivity, rather than stronger intergenerational transmission of human capital or changes in assortative mating. Finally, we show that parent-child correlations increase mainly when women gain access to jobs that match their productivity.
abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚地区统一的行政数据，我们发现，对于1951年至1979年间出生的群体，瑞典、丹麦和挪威的收入代际排名关联性均呈现一致增强趋势。按性别划分，父子间的流动性保持稳定，而母亲与女儿间的相关性则上升。美国调查数据中出现了类似模式，尽管时间节点有所不同。我们证明，收入流动性的下降反映了女性收入与其潜在生产力之间更强的联系，而非人力资本代际传递的增强或匹配性婚姻的变化。最后，我们指出，亲子相关性主要是在女性获得与其生产力相匹配的工作机会时增加。

title: Does frequent cross-industry portfolio rebalancing by mutual funds introduce vulnerability into stocks?
title_zh: 共同基金频繁的跨行业投资组合再平衡是否会给股票带来脆弱性？
title_primary: 共同基金频繁的跨行业投资组合再平衡是否会给股票带来脆弱性？
title_secondary: Does frequent cross-industry portfolio rebalancing by mutual funds introduce vulnerability into stocks?
authors: Jianxiang Liu, Pengxiang Zhao
official: 官方在线 2025-09-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Does the behaviour of mutual fund managers chasing hot trends and frequently rebalancing across industries introduce vulnerability into the corporate stocks? To address this issue, we create a novel stock-level potential vulnerability measure based on the cross-industry rebalancing magnitude of mutual funds holding the stock. We find that stocks bearing higher vulnerability subsequently experience higher crash risk. Fund style drift and fund illiquidity cannot account for our findings. Further analysis suggests that this positive effect is primarily realized through channels such as delaying the integration of negative corporate information into prices and boosting price bubbles. abstract_zh: 共同基金管理者追逐热门趋势并频繁跨行业调整投资组合的行为，是否会增加企业股票的脆弱性？为探究这一问题，我们基于持有某只股票的共同基金跨行业调整幅度，构建了一种全新的股票层面潜在脆弱性度量指标。研究发现，脆弱性较高的股票随后会面临更高的崩盘风险。基金风格漂移与基金流动性不足无法解释这一结果。进一步分析表明，这种正向效应主要通过延迟负面企业信息融入价格以及助推价格泡沫等渠道实现。关键词：频繁跨行业投资组合调整 崩盘风险 股票价格泡沫 基金风格漂移 基金流动性不足 JEL分类：G00 G01 G23
